newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kabila not due in Kinshasa for days, aide says.
newsitem.headline: Kabila not due in Kinshasa for days, aide says.

text.p: Laurent Kabila, the self-declared president of the new Democratic Republic of Congo, is not expected to arrive in the capital Kinshasa for several days and possibly one week, a senior aide said on Monday.
"It could be three days, five days, a week. It could be in a week," Deogratius Bugera, Secretary-General of the Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo, told reporters.
"He has preoccupations. He is busy," he added.

Following a seven-month civil war, Kabila's rebels took Kinshasa on Saturday and renamed Zaire as the Democratic Republic of Congo. His move came one day after president Mobutu Sese Seko fled the capital.
